description: ApplyESA BIC Andalusia2026-09-28T14:53:44+02:00 The Open Call for Proposals is now OPENNext cut-off date: 30 October 2026 at 12:00 CET. Download the Application Package below to apply to ESA BIC Andalusia Download the Application Package (.zip)Who Can ApplyEnsure your startup can join our incubation programme To be eligible for ESA BIC Andalusia, your startup or business idea must meet the following criteria: Space-Related InnovationYour business must have a solid connection to space-related technology, expertise, or applications. This connection can be categorized as either Downstream or Upstream: Downstream This involves the application or exploitation of space systems or technologies in non-space domains. Your business idea may focus on: Applications utilizing satellite navigation, earth observation, or satellite communication.Technology transfer involving space-related hardware, software, or intellectual property.Providing solutions that leverage space data or technology to innovate in other sectorsUpstream This relates to the development of new technologies intended for use within the space sector. Examples include: Developing new systems, subsystems, or components for space missions.Technologies and services designed for use on space missions or in human spaceflight activities.Your application must clearly justify the space connection, demonstrating how it advances or innovates within the space sector. It is crucial that the space connection is clear and justified in your application. For further guidance on ensuring your idea meets the necessary criteria, please consult the Space Connection Assessment document. This will help you evaluate and articulate the space connection of your business idea to meet the requirements set by ESA BIC Andalusia. Viable Business PlanYou must present a clear and viable business plan outlining your strategy for growth, the market potential of your product or service, and how your space-related innovation will be commercialized. The business plan should also detail financial projections, key milestones, and risk management strategies. Company AgeNew or existing companies less than 5 years old. If Your Company is Already Established Your startup must be legally registered in Spain and must not be older than five years at the time of application. If Your Company is Not Yet Established You are eligible to apply as an informal group of entrepreneurs, provided you commit to legally registering your startup in Andalusia upon acceptance into the programme. Company LocationYour business must be, or commit to being, located in Andalusia during the incubation period. ESA BIC Andalusia is strategically located in the Naves de Renfe building in the San Jerónimo district of Seville, near the Spanish Space Agency headquarters. Commitment to the programmeYour team must be fully committed to engaging with the ESA BIC Andalusia programme throughout the entire incubation period. This includes regular attendance at workshops, mentoring sessions, and events organized by the incubator, as well as making full use of the resources provided. How to ApplyFollow these steps and turn your ideas into successful businesses Check Your EligibilityEnsure your startup meets the eligibility criteria for ESA BIC Andalusia. If you are unsure, visit the Who can apply section for more information. Contact Our TeamIt is highly recommended to contact ESA BIC Andalusia in advance to inform us about your intention to apply. title: ESA BIC Padua — space startup incubation, 2026 application round
funder: ESA BIC Padua / local programme operator
description: Every second, global positioning satellites allow precise tracking everywhere on the Earth surface. Every minute, telecommunication satellites support access to information networks globally. Every hour, meteorological and Earth Observation satellites enable monitoring and awareness of our Earth. What is your next horizon? MANAGED BY IN COLLABORATION WITH WITH THE SUPPORT OF Next Cut Off date November 18th, 2026 Days Hours Minutes Seconds Go to the Application procedure Q&A Breakfast Join us for a Q&A session and learn how to apply to the ESA BIC Program successfully. Get essential tips on how to prepare your application for ESABIC.Register here below for the meet-up taking place April 8th, at 10.00 AM @ Officina Stellare Heartquarter in Sarcedo (VI) REGISTER TO THE Q&A BREAKFAST ESA BIC Padua The ESA Business Incubation Centre Padua is an initiative powered by the European Space Agency and provides start-ups with technical expertise and facilities, business support, networking, office space and funding needed to help and accelerate their business growth. Part of ESA’s successful European network of Business Incubation Centres, ESA BIC Padua is managed by Officina Stellare SpA, a leading name worldwide for its capacity to design and manufacture of high technology opto-mechanical system instrumentation for the Aerospace, Scientific Research and Defense-related end-markets.ESA BIC Padua aims to provide startups with a unique environment to accelerate innovation and unlock their commercial potential. Who Can Apply? •Companies registered in Italy • New or existing companies less than 5 years old • The startups must have a space-related, verifiable business and a viable Business Plan When to apply? The ESA BIC Open Call for Applications is permanently open. The selection and evaluation of applications are scheduled periodically with deadlines published on this website. PLEASE NOTE: we strongly suggest you contact us in advance to introduce your business idea and receive all information about the incubation program. How to Apply? To apply to the Open Call, download and read the ESA BIC Padua Application Package. Complete your application by filling in the following documents: Cover Letter and Requirements Checklist Business Plan Incubation Proposal Related Annexes Submit your application within the deadline through the Application Form. PLEASE NOTE: remember to specify the Node you are applying for, Padua Apply Now About the Program The ESA BIC Startups incubation program lasts 2 years and includes: Financial Support Up to 50K Euro zero-equity funding provided By ESA and ESA BIC Padua partners. Technical Support 80 hours of Technical coaching Business Legal Support 50 hours Management/Business coaching10 hours IPR/Legal Services Partner Network Access to a broad network of corporate, research partners, investors ESA Network & Community Building Access to the international ESA Commercialization Gateway community and SBIC alumni network Exclusive Events Exclusive access to national and international events; workshops, masterclasses and training sessions. ESA BUSINESS INCUBATION CENTRES The Largest Incubation Network in Europe ESA Business Incubation Centres (ESA BICs) are the largest network of incubators supporting space related start-ups in Europe. The objective is to support entrepreneurs with a space-based business idea and help them developing their product while getting their company off the ground. In the process, they create and grow clusters of space-related start-ups across Europe. Discover the ESA BIC Network Wish to know more? Get updates signing to our newsletter or send us your message if you have any question. Get in Touch

IMAGINE BOOSTING YOUR BUSINESS BEYOND THE STARS New deadline for submitting proposals: 13th november 2026 (23:59 CET) We are the European Space Agency Business Incubation Center in Barcelona We aim to support aspiring innovative start-ups. We seek entrepreneurs who: Develop applications leveraging space-based systems, such as satellite navigation, Earth observation, or satellite communication. Apply space technologies in non-space domains, driving cross-industry innovation. Create innovative products and services for the space sector, contributing to its growth and advancement. We Offer 60,000 EUR funding(non – equity) Technical support Business coaching and advise Legal and IPR support Office facilities Use of ESA BIC brand Innovation ecosystemconnection ESA BIC community To apply for the ESA BIC Barcelonayou must have an innovative idea witha strong space connection.
